summary.en: Markets eye NVIDIA's Q2 earnings report and July PCE inflation data, with Dow futures rising while Nasdaq slips ahead of AI chip giant results. Oil prices soften on constructive Oman-Iran talks easing Hormuz Strait concerns, while Treasury yields edge higher ahead of Fed's preferred inflation gauge release. Geopolitical developments in Middle East continue to drive cross-asset transmission from energy to inflation expectations.
summary.zh: 市场聚焦 NVIDIA 第二季财报和七月 PCE 通胀数据，道指期货上涨而纳斯达克下跌以等待 AI 芯片巨头业绩。油价因阿曼伊朗对话缓和霍尔木兹海峡担忧而回落，美债收益率在美联储偏好通胀指标发布前小幅走高。中东地缘政治发展继续驱动能源向通胀预期的跨资产传导。

title.en: NVIDIA Reports Q2 FY27 Earnings, Guidance Near $91B Revenue as AI Chip Demand Surges
title.zh: NVIDIA 发布 Q2 FY27 财报，指引营收接近 910 亿美元，AI 芯片需求激增

impact.en: Breaking earnings catalyst for semiconductor/AI sectors; results could trigger broad AI stock rotation and influence big tech performance.
impact.zh: 半导体/AI 板块的重大业绩催化剂；结果可能引发广泛 AI 股票轮动并影响大科技股表现。

macroRisk.en: No - company-specific catalyst, but AI sector leadership could affect tech breadth.

title.en: US July PCE Inflation Data Due at 8:30 AM ET; Core Prices Keep Pressure on Fed Rate Path
title.zh: 美国七月 PCE 通胀数据将于美东时间 8:30 发布；核心物价继续给美联储路径施压

impact.en: Key inflation gauge ahead of Jackson Hole; market pricing in rate cut timeline and bond yield sensitivity.
impact.zh: 杰克逊霍尔会议前的关键通胀指标；市场对降息时间表和债券收益率敏感性定价。

macroRisk.en: Yes - higher PCE could delay rate cuts, press yields higher, and trigger sector rotation away from duration-sensitive names.

title.en: Oil Falls to ~$80/bbl on Constructive Oman-Iran Talks Easing Hormuz Strait Tensions
title.zh: 油价跌至约 80 美元/桶，阿曼伊朗对话缓和霍尔木兹海峡紧张局势

impact.en: Geopolitical risk premium receding; cross-asset impact: lower oil → softer inflation expectations → Treasury yields may stabilize.
impact.zh: 地缘政治风险溢价消退；跨资产影响：油价下跌→通胀预期减弱→美债收益率可能稳定。

macroRisk.en: Yes - oil prices directly influence inflation expectations and Fed policy path.

title.en: Treasury Yields Edge Higher as Markets Await PCE Data; 10Y Near 4.70%
title.zh: 美债收益率在等待 PCE 数据前小幅走高；10 年期接近 4.70%

impact.en: Rate-sensitive sectors face headwinds; yield stability could support tech valuations.
impact.zh: 利率敏感板块面临阻力；收益率稳定可能支持科技股估值。

macroRisk.en: Yes - yield trajectory sets tone for growth stock valuations and duration positioning.

title.en: Gold Pulls Back from $4,700 High Ahead of PCE; Silver Holds Near $68.50 After 17% Monthly Gain
title.zh: 金价在 PCE 发布前从 4700 美元高位回落；银价在单月上涨 17% 后维持在 68.50 美元附近

impact.en: Safe haven asset sensitivity to inflation expectations and real yields; geopolitical hedge.
impact.zh: 避险资产对通胀预期和实际收益率敏感；地缘政治对冲。

macroRisk.en: Yes - precious metals serve as inflation hedge and geopolitical risk buffer.

title.en: AMD Shares Jump 4.9% on Server-CPU Upgrade; Raymond James Upgrades to Strong Buy
title.zh: AMD 股票因服务器 CPU 升级上涨 4.9%；雷蒙德詹姆斯公司上调为强烈买入

impact.en: AI infrastructure momentum continues; competitive positioning versus NVIDIA important for semiconductor sector.
impact.zh: AI 基础设施势头持续；与 NVIDIA 的竞争定位对半导体部门很重要。

macroRisk.en: No - company-specific positive catalyst within broader tech rally context.

title.en: European Markets Rally Overnight: DAX +0.38%, EuroStoxx +0.43%; Asian Indices Mixed
title.zh: 欧洲市场隔夜上涨：DAX 涨 0.38%，欧洲 Stoxx 涨 0.43%；亚洲指数分化

impact.en: International breadth and trade-weighted portfolio implications; euro area economic data influences USD strength.
impact.zh: 国际广度和贸易加权投资组合影响；欧元区经济数据影响美元强势。

macroRisk.en: No - international market moves provide breadth signal without direct macro transmission.

ai.en: NVIDIA earnings dominate; AI chip demand remains robust. TSMC expected to benefit from NVDA success; AMD gaining share with MI300 series. Sector breadth at risk if macro headwinds intensify.
ai.zh: NVIDIA 财报主导；AI 芯片需求保持强劲。TSMC 预期受益于 NVDA 成功；AMD 凭借 MI300 系列获得市场份额。如果宏观阻力加剧，板块广度面临风险。

semiconductor.en: Semis poised around NVDA results; AMD up on server CPU momentum. Cyclical inventory build in AI segment continues. Memory chip prices stabilizing.
semiconductor.zh: 半导体围绕 NVDA 结果布局；AMD 因服务器 CPU 势头上涨。AI 部门的周期性库存积累继续。内存芯片价格稳定。

bigTech.en: Mixed sentiment awaiting PCE; cloud/AI infrastructure spend supports growth but rate sensitivity creates uncertainty. Magnificent Seven face inflation data test.
bigTech.zh: 等待 PCE 时情绪分化；云/AI 基础设施支出支持增长，但对利率敏感造成不确定性。七巨头面临通胀数据考验。

energy.en: Oil at $80/bbl level after geopolitical risk premium recedes. OPEC+ discipline supports floor; US production capacity remains robust despite price softening.
energy.zh: 油价在地缘政治风险溢价消退后稳定在 80 美元/桶。OPEC+ 纪律支撑底部；尽管价格疲软，美国产量产能保持强劲。

ev.en: EV sector muted awaiting broader macro regime; rate sensitivity persists. China demand uncertainty from trade dynamics and geopolitical tensions weighs on sentiment.
ev.zh: 电动车板块等待更广泛的宏观环境；利率敏感性持续。中国需求因贸易动态和地缘政治紧张而存在不确定性，拖累情绪。

market.en: Dow futures slight up while Nasdaq slips; sector divergence on earnings catalysts. Mixed breadth pre-earnings with AI leaders outperforming but consumer/rate-sensitive names lagging.
market.zh: 道指期货小幅上涨，纳斯达克下跌；业绩催化剂导致行业分化。业绩发布前的混合广度，AI 领导者跑赢，但对消费者和利率敏感的个股落后。

preciousMetals.en: Gold pulling back from multi-month highs ahead of PCE; silver resilient after strong monthly performance. Safe haven flows may resume if inflation surprises emerge or geopolitics escalates.
preciousMetals.zh: 金价在 PCE 发布前从数月高点回落；银价在强劲的月度表现后保持韧性。如果通胀数据超预期或地缘政治升级，避险资金流可能恢复。

oil.en: WTI ~$80, Brent ~$86 after Oman-Iran talks progress. Middle East peace prospects and US pressure on Iran provide risk-off backdrop. Supply disruptions remain limited despite geopolitical headlines.
oil.zh: WTI 约 80 美元，布伦特约 86 美元，在阿曼伊朗对话进展后。中东和平前景和美国对伊朗施压提供风险厌恶背景。尽管有地缘政治头条消息，供应中断仍然有限。

futures.en: Dow Futures +19 pts (0.04%), S&P 500 Futures -10 pts (-0.13%), Nasdaq 100 Futures -109 pts (-0.37%). Dow strength offsets broader tech weakness.
futures.zh: 道指期货 +19 点（0.04%），标普 500 期货 -10 点（-0.13%），纳斯达克 100 期货 -109 点（-0.37%）。道指强劲抵消了更广泛的技术股弱势。

treasury10Y.en: 10Y Treasury yield near 4.70%, climbing ahead of PCE data release at 8:30 AM ET. Market pricing in hold/monsoon policy stance.
treasury10Y.zh: 10 年期美债收益率接近 4.70%，在上午 8:30（美东时间）发布 PCE 数据前攀升。市场定价维持/季风政策立场。

dxy.en: USD modestly stronger at 1.166 EUR/USD inversion (9574). Euro area growth and ECB policy divergence supports dollar strength.
dxy.zh: 美元适度走强，9574 的 1.166 欧元/美元倒数。欧元区增长和欧洲央行政策分化支持美元强势。

oil.en: WTI crude futures at $80.26, Brent at $86.20 after declining on Middle East de-escalation. Risk premium compressing.
oil.zh: WTI 原油期货在$80.26，布伦特在$86.20，在因中东局势缓和后下跌。风险溢价压缩。

keyRisk.en: NVIDIA earnings miss could trigger broader AI sector sell-off and tech rotation to value/lagging sectors.
keyRisk.zh: NVIDIA 业绩不及预期可能引发更广泛的 AI 板块抛售并转向价值和滞后的行业。

note.en: Mixed sentiment driven by divergent factors: AI catalysts vs. inflation fears, oil de-escalation vs. earnings volatility. Dow strength offsets Nasdaq weakness; sector-specific rotation expected.
note.zh: 情绪分化由不同因素驱动：AI 催化剂与通胀担忧，油价缓和与业绩波动。道指强劲抵消纳斯达克弱势；预期行业特定轮动。
